课程简介（中文）

本门课程主要介绍概率论和数理统计学中的常见基本概念。课程内容包括概率论基本概念、基础知识，包括随机变量、期望、方差，以及统计学中基础概念，包括点估计、假设检验、置信区间，包括大样本理论。

课程简介（英文）

This course mainly introduces common fundamental concepts in probability theory and mathematical statistics. The course covers basic concepts and principles of probability theory, including random variables, expectation, and variance, as well as fundamental concepts in statistics, including point estimation, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and large-sample theory.

教学目标

1.  介绍概率论基本概念，包括随机变量，期望，方差，大样本理论等。

2. 介绍数理统计学的基本方法和理论，包括点估计，置信区间，假设检验等。

3. 介绍数理统计学的应用，包括在人工智能、医疗影像方面的应用。

教学方式

课堂教学、平时作业、文献阅读、期末project。

教学内容与进度安排

 

  1. Introduction and Probability
  2. Random Variables (Definition, Discrete and Continuous variables)
  3. Random Variables (Expectation, Variance, Joint distribution)
  4. Random Variables (Transformation of random variables, properties of mean and variance, order statistics, moment-generating functions)
  5. Special Distributions (Poisson, Normal, etc.)
  6. Estimation (Maximum likelihood estimation, interval estimation)
  7. Estimation (Properties of estimators, minimum variance estimators, sufficient estimators)
  8. Hypothesis Testing
  9. Inferences based on Normal Distributions
  10. Two-sample Inferences
  11. Goodness of Fit tests
  12. Regression
  13. The Analysis of Variance
  14. Randomized Block Designs
  15. Non-parametric Statistics.
  16. Project presentation
